text:
mia: Quick heads-up — config-gate flagged a checksum mismatch for the new model drop (m-stable-3b) on PR #4921. Not urgent-yet but blocking serve-config gate :eyes:

oliver: link?

mia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4921 — CI output: "weights.integrity mismatch" and a tokenizer pad_token_id mismatch. Validator printed: "expected sha256=3a7f... got 5c2b..."

ci-bot: config-lint failed: (config.json) weights.integrity != computed; tokenizer.pad_token_id is 1 but tokenizer.json defines pad token at 0. Full logs attached in CI artifact.

sasha: I skimmed the tokenizer artifact — looks like a subtoken shift from byte-normalization changes. The tokenizer was generated with our old normalize config (strip_accents=false) vs new default. That will shift special token indices.

rahul: Could be a simple artifact mismatch: weights were re-uploaded after a minor patch and tokenizer stayed stale. Two immediate paths: 1) re-generate tokenizer from the final vocab and push a new tokenizer.tar.gz + update integrity, or 2) in config.json add an explicit tokenizer.overrides.pad_token_id to preserve backward compatibility while we re-ingest.

mia: Agreed. Plan suggestion: re-upload corrected tokenizer artifact (preferred), update weights.integrity to match, and let gate re-run. If we need a temporary shim, add tokenizer.overrides.pad_token_id. Also tagging @lee for a quick review of any config changes. :wave:

lee: I'll take a look. Small notes from serving side: if pad_token_id missing we compute it at runtime from tokenizer.tokens["<pad>"] and emit a warn. But it's better to keep the manifest authoritative. Also we should ensure config schema requires weights.integrity when weights.source is external.

oliver: For reproducibility, here's the checksum helper I used locally:

```bash
# compute sha256 for weights file in GCS
gsutil cat gs://model-bucket/m-stable-3b/weights.bin | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
# OR with s3
aws s3 cp s3://model-bucket/m-stable-3b/weights.bin - | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1
```

sasha: Also verify tokenizer metadata: open tokenizer.json and confirm special_tokens mapping and vocab_size. Example quick check: `jq '.special_tokens."<pad>"' tokenizer.json` — if it returns null, that's the problem.

mia: I'll upload a corrected tokenizer tarball (tokenizer.json + merges) tonight and push an updated manifest with the new weights.integrity. ETA EOD for tokenizer, weights by 12:30 PDT tomorrow.

rahul: If you want a hand with the upload/GC permissions, ping me and I can do the transfer to the canonical bucket and set ACLs.

lee: One follow-up for the config schema: we should add a lint rule that enforces presence of either weights.integrity OR a signed manifest URL. Also add a default for max_sequence (if missing, set to 2048) so onboarding doesn't fail consumptions that rely on that field. I'll open a small PR to config-lint.

oliver: tiny nit: the validator should annotate which field triggered the backcompat fallback — saves time. Maybe include the offending key path in the error summary.

mia: Great — I'll: 1) upload tokenizer artifact, 2) update manifest with new integrity, 3) add tokenizer.overrides pad shim in PR as short-term if needed, 4) cc @lee on the config-lint PR. If anyone wants to pair on the upload I can screenshare at 4pm. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Re-run requested by mia — awaiting new artifacts.

mia: Thanks team. I'll post updates here when artifacts are live.
